title: 第5章 第一次进化第6章 白眼僵尸
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
不仅如此，根据系统上面所显示出来的信息。
随着自己的这个僵尸灵宠进化，成长力还能够继续提升。
要知道对于所有的灵宠来说，成长力就将决定其成长的上限。
在这个御灵的世界，灵宠的成长力一共分为八个等级。
分别是废物，平庸，普通，稀有，稀世，史诗，传说，神话。
虽然现在成长力的最高等级是神话级，但是就目前整个联邦的情况来看，成长力最高的记录，也仅仅只有传说级。
神话级，是联邦之中，多数人的猜测。
其中最相信这一点的，就是那些拥有传说级灵宠的大佬。
他们都认为还有更高级的灵宠存在，但是现在，还没有人能够进化到那一个阶段。
不同成长力的灵宠，成长也有着各自的上限。
废物级，最多就只能提升到四阶十级，平庸最多就五阶十级，以此类推。
只有史诗级的灵宠，才有机会提升到九阶十级，至于更高一阶段传说灵宠，那就更不用说了。
在同等级情况下，成长力越高的灵宠，就会越有优势。
因为成长力越高，掌握的天赋和技能就可能会越多，自然就更有优势。
而叶凌现在的黑眼僵尸，成长力就排在第二阶段，仅仅只是比废物好上那么一点。
当然，现在已经看到了希望的他，自然不会认为自己的黑眼僵尸是一个废物。
要知道，黑眼僵尸最终进化阶段的红眼僵尸王，成长力可是神话级别的。
而现在整个大陆上，即使是传说级的灵宠，也是少之又少，每一个都是处在金字塔的顶端。
这能够进化为神话级红眼僵尸王的黑眼僵尸，可以想象有多恐怖，当然是在未来。
“有御灵系统存在，顶级御灵使学院，完全是唾手可得！”

目光出神的看着系统面板，叶凌心中也是一阵狂喜。
如果资源足够的情况下，叶凌甚至可以成为大陆上第一个拥有神话宠物的存在。
这件事传出去，不用想，百分之百都没人会相信，甚至会以为他是疯子。
因为到现在为止，都还没人摸索到如何进化为神话级。
当然，这前提是资源足够，灵宠的每一次进化，都需要消耗一定的资源，才有机会完成进化。
越到后面，各种各样的资源材料都会更加珍贵且稀有。
而这些资源，基本上都是来自于大陆上各个地方的魔物。
要想获取这些资源，只有两条路可以走。
一种就是自己去猎杀对应的魔物获取，还有一种就是通过市场上的贩卖获取。
主要就是这两种获取资源的通道，而孤身一人的叶凌，完全就是靠着联邦的帮助，才有机会成为学生。
content_en:
Not only that, according to the information displayed on the system.
As this zombie pet of yours evolves, its growth ability can continue to increase.
You must know that for all spiritual pets, their growth power will determine the upper limit of their growth.
In this world of controlling spirits, the growth ability of spiritual pets is divided into eight levels.
They are trash, mediocre, common, rare, rare, epic, legend, and myth.
Although the current highest level of growth power is mythical level, judging from the current situation of the entire federation, the record for the highest growth power is only legendary level.
The mythical level is the guess of most people in the federation.
Among them, the ones who believe this the most are the bosses who have legendary spiritual pets.
They all believe that there are more advanced spiritual pets, but currently, no one has been able to evolve to that stage.
Spiritual pets with different growth abilities also have their own upper limits for growth.
A useless person can only be promoted to level four or ten at most, a mediocre person can only be promoted to level five or ten at most, and so on.
Only epic-level spiritual pets have the chance to be promoted to level nine or ten. As for legendary spiritual pets at the higher level, that's not even mentionable.
At the same level, a spiritual pet with a higher growth rate will have an advantage.
Because the higher the growth ability, the more talents and skills you may master, and you will naturally have more advantages.
As for Ye Ling's current black-eyed zombie, its growth rate is in the second stage, just a little better than trash.
Of course, now that he has seen hope, he naturally will not think that his black-eyed zombie is a waste.
You know, the red-eyed zombie king in the final evolutionary stage of the black-eyed zombie has a mythical level of growth.
But now on the entire continent, there are very few even legendary spiritual pets, and every one of them is at the top of the pyramid.
This black-eyed zombie can evolve into a mythical red-eyed zombie king. You can imagine how terrifying it is, of course in the future.
"With the existence of the Spirit Controlling System, the top Spirit Controlling Academy is completely within your reach!"
Looking at the system panel with ecstasy, Ye Ling felt ecstatic in his heart.
If there are enough resources, Ye Ling can even become the first person on the mainland to own a mythical pet.
If this news spreads, no one will believe it, and they will even think that he is a lunatic.
Because until now, no one has figured out how to evolve to the mythical level.
Of course, this presupposes that there are sufficient resources. Each evolution of the spiritual pet requires a certain amount of resources to have a chance to complete the evolution.
As you go to the back, various resources and materials will become more precious and rare.
And these resources basically come from monsters from various places on the continent.
There are only two ways to obtain these resources.
One is to hunt the corresponding monsters yourself, and the other is to obtain them by selling them in the market.
These are the two main ways to obtain resources, and Ye Ling, who is alone, only has the opportunity to become a student with the help of the federation.
